text_en: Then after fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along with me.
text_cn: 过了十四年，我同巴尔纳伯再上耶路撒冷去，还带了弟铎同去。

text_en: I went up in response to a revelation. Then I laid before them (though only in a private meeting with the acknowledged leaders) the gospel that I proclaim among the Gentiles, in order to make sure that I was not running, or had not run, in vain.
text_cn: 我是受了启示而上去的；我在那里向他们陈述了我在异民中间所讲的福音，和私下向那些有权威的人陈述过，免得我白白地奔跑，或者徒然奔走了。

text_en: But even Titus, who was with me, was not compelled to be circumcised, though he was a Greek.
text_cn: 但是，即连跟我的弟铎，他虽是希腊人，也没有被强迫领受割损，

text_en: But because of false believers secretly brought in, who slipped in to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might enslave us—
text_cn: 因为，有些潜入的假弟兄，曾要他受割损；这些人潜入了教会，是为窥探我们在基督耶稣内所享有的自由，好使我们再成为奴隶；

text_en: we did not submit to them even for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel might always remain with you.
text_cn: 可是对他们，我们连片刻时间也没有让步屈服，为使福音的真理在你们中保持不变。

text_en: And from those who were supposed to be acknowledged leaders (what they actually were makes no difference to me; God shows no partiality)—those leaders contributed nothing to me.
text_cn: 至于那些所谓有权威的人──不论他们以前是何等人物，与我毫不相干；天主决不顾情面──那些有权威的人，也没有另外吩咐我什么；

text_en: On the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the gospel for the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been entrusted with the gospel for the circumcised
text_cn: 反而他们看出来，我是受了委托，向未受割损的人，宣传福音，就如伯多禄被委派向受割损的人宣传福音一样；

text_en: (for he who worked through Peter making him an apostle to the circumcised also worked through me in sending me to the Gentiles),
text_cn: 因为，那叫伯多禄为受割损的人致力尽宗徒之职的，也叫我为外邦人致力尽宗徒之职。

text_en: and when James and Cephas and John, who were acknowledged pillars, recognized the grace that had been given to me, they gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, agreeing that we should go to the Gentiles and they to the circumcised.
text_cn: 所以，他们一认清了所赋与我的恩宠，那称为柱石的雅各伯、刻法和若望，就与我和巴尔纳伯握手，表示通力合作，叫我们往外邦人那里去，而他们却往受割损的人那里去。

text_en: They asked only one thing, that we remember the poor, which was actually what I was eager to do.
text_cn: 他们只要我们怀念穷人；对这一点我也曾尽力行了。

text_en: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he stood self-condemned;
text_cn: 但是，当刻法来到安提约基雅时，我当面反对了他，因为他有可责的地方。

text_en: for until certain people came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But after they came, he drew back and kept himself separate for fear of the circumcision faction.
text_cn: 原来由雅各伯那里来了一些人，在他们未到以前，他惯常同外邦人一起吃饭；可是他们一来到了，他因怕那些受割损的人，就退避了，自己躲开。

text_en: And the other Jews joined him in this hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.
text_cn: 其余的犹太人也都跟他一起装假，以致连巴尔纳伯也受了他们的牵引而装假。

text_en: But when I saw that they were not acting consistently with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas before them all, “If you, though a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews? ”
text_cn: 我一见他们的行为与福音的真理不合，就当着众人对刻法说：“你是犹太人，竟按照外邦人的方式，而不按照犹太人的方式过活，你怎么敢强迫外邦人犹太化呢？”

text_en: We ourselves are Jews by birth and not Gentile sinners;
text_cn: 我们生来是犹太人，而不是出于外邦民族的罪人；

text_en: yet we know that a person is justified not by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ. And we have come to believe in Christ Jesus, so that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by doing the works of the law, because no one will be justified by the works of the law.
text_cn: 可是我们知道：人成义不是由于遵行法律，而只是因着对耶稣基督的信仰，所以我们也信从了基督耶稣，为能由于对基督的信仰，而不由于遵行法律成义，因为由于遵守法律，任何人都不得成义。

text_en: But if, in our effort to be justified in Christ, we ourselves have been found to be sinners, is Christ then a servant of sin? Certainly not!
text_cn: 如果我们在基督内求成义的人，仍如他们一样被视为罪人，那么，基督岂不是成了支持罪恶的人了吗？绝对不是。

text_en: But if I build up again the very things that I once tore down, then I demonstrate that I am a transgressor.
text_cn: 如果我把我所拆毁的，再修建起来，我就证明我是个罪犯。

text_en: For through the law I died to the law, so that I might live to God. I have been crucified with Christ;
text_cn: 其实，我已由于法律而死于法律了，为能生活于天主；我已同基督被钉在十字架上了，

text_en: and it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me. And the life I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
text_cn: 所以，我生活已不是我生活，而是基督在我内生活；我现今在肉身内生活，是生活在对天主子的信仰内；他爱了我，且为我舍弃了自己。

text_en: I do not nullify the grace of God; for if justification comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
text_cn: 我决不愿使天主的恩宠无效，因为，如果成义是赖着法律，那么，基督就白白地死了。
